title: ipomoea linosepala subsp. alpina
intro: Ipomoea linosepala subsp. alpina, commonly known as Morning Glory, is a species of flowering plant in the Convolvulaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Ipomoea linosepala subsp. alpina include acting as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and vasodilator, which may help to lower blood pressure and improve circulation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
